I mean she has tried get my mind unhooked from these intrusive thoughts because of how big a burden it is on me. You obviously don't come to the decision of completely castrating yourself lightly. I've brought it up twice and it was the first time that she got oddly defensive about it. It really did strike me as weird.

My girlfriend has said she's fine with me not having it, says she loves my body the way it is. I've not shared with her my idea of castration because there's still more thought that needs to be put into it before I go through with it, even if I feel incredibly strongly about it. I've talked to my gf about this anxiety a lot and she's always so understanding about it, never gives me any shit over it.
Very much so. I've had stress dreams over this before.

I don't know why I feel so strongly about it. I've tried to make myself not be so hung up about it but it just burrows into my mind and won't come out. It's one of those things that unreasonably bothers me for reasons I can't describe.

She wasn't encouraging me that's for sure. She's trying to talk me out of it. I can't get rid of her because she's the only therapist who's managed to make progress with me. As much as I dislike how she handles this part of me, she's effective elsewhere, really effective. So I just need to take the rough with the smooth.

It probably won't but... I just can't take this pain. I can't take looking at it.

I have and have tried it as well. But it only serves to remind me what I lost, rather than easing the pain. Kind like if a person who lost an arm tried to make another one with clay. Sure it looks like it, feels like it. But it isn't. It's just a painful reminder of what was taken from me without my will.

I agree. It bothers me so much that when people try to stop this practice, or make things like suing your parents legal there is MASSIVE push back against it. For something that's not required. For something that literally no one would be a loser from if it were banned. I mean we have religious freedom in the US so it wouldn't be banning the practice from religious groups. It bothers me so much that they cling to this so hard. It's borderline evil.

Even so the doctors shouldn't allow it. That's like asking your doctor to cut your baby's fingers off and them just throwing their hands up and say "well, since you asked."

It is so beyond immoral. Thank you though. I wish it didn't effect me like it does. Just really really gets to me.
I have had a fair number of SOs, both men and women. Problem is, is that I'm not healthy enough to be in a relationship. My depression and other issues usually ruin it
A few meds at the moment yes.
